en.title: Japan Boosts Disability Employment Rate; New Eye‑Input App Launches; Shrine Access Guide Published
en.summary: Japan raised the statutory disability employment rate from 2.3% to 2.7% effective July 1 to promote inclusive hiring. An eye‑tracking app 'AiMotto' was launched for severe disabilities, and a guide details accessible routes to Izumo Taisha Shrine for wheelchair users.

highlights.title: Japan raises statutory disability employment rate to 2.7%
Eye‑input app developed for people with severe disabilities
Wheelchair User's Accessible Visit to Izumo Taisha Shrine

zh-TW.title: 日本提高殘障就業率至2.7%；眼動App AiMotto上市；出雲大社無障礙指南發布
zh-TW.summary: 日本自7月1日起將殘障法定就業率從2.3%提升至2.7%，以促進包容性僱用。岩手縣大學講師開發的眼動追蹤應用『AiMotto』已針對重度障礙者全面推出。此外，出雲大社提供輪椅使用者的坡道、停車場及無障礙廁所詳細資訊，方便參觀。
